title: Supplier Quality Management
thesis: Snowflake ingests and parses supplier audit documents, indexes Thai automotive quality standards for instant retrieval, classifies supplier risk, and alerts procurement — replacing manual compliance tracking with AI-native workflows

talking_points: One point two billion baht in Cost of Poor Quality across 220 suppliers this year.
Fourteen suppliers flagged as HIGH RISK — risk score above 80.
Twenty-three audits overdue by more than 30 days.
show: Point at the ฿1.2B COPQ KPI card
Highlight the 14 high-risk suppliers in red

transition.line: Let's drill into which suppliers are driving quality cost.

talking_points: Supplier S-0047 (Siam Parts Manufacturing) — risk score 92, twelve NCRs in 90 days.
AI_PARSE_DOCUMENT extracted 47 findings from their last audit PDF automatically.
ML.ANOMALY_DETECTION flags S-0047 quality metrics as anomalous for 8 consecutive weeks.
show: Click S-0047 in the risk-ranked supplier list
tabs.call_out: 8 consecutive weeks anomalous — systemic quality failure

transition.line: What do the quality standards say about this type of non-conformance?

talking_points: Cortex Search indexes 150 quality standards — IATF 16949, TISI, and OEM-specific requirements.
Search 'dimensional tolerance for brake components' returns the exact IATF clause and Thai standard.
AI generates a gap analysis between supplier performance and standard requirements.
tabs.call_out: 150 standards searchable in natural language — instant compliance lookup

transition.line: Now let the Head of SQE ask the system directly.

talking_points: Prasert asks: 'Which suppliers have the highest COPQ this quarter?'
Cortex Analyst generates SQL, returns: S-0047 ฿87M, S-0112 ฿64M, S-0089 ฿52M.
Switch to advisor: 'Recommend actions for S-0047' — references audit findings and IATF standards.
show: Type: 'Top 5 suppliers by COPQ this quarter'
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: SQL analytics + compliance advisory

talking_points: Seven Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services.
Textract/AI_PARSE_DOCUMENT processes 450 audit PDFs into structured data.
Thailand is the world's 12th-largest auto producer — 1.88M vehicles in 2023. This monitors 220 suppliers.
tabs.call_out: One platform, native SQL, document AI built-in

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for automotive supplier quality in Thailand.
